sections.h2: Tracking Under Oman's Data Protection Law

paragraphs.html: Oman's Personal Data Protection Law, issued by Royal Decree No. 6/2022, came into force in February 2023 and is overseen by the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT), which issued its executive regulations in 2024. For SEO, this mainly affects how your website tracks visitors and collects form data. We set up Google Analytics 4 with a clear consent banner, a plain privacy notice and lead forms that ask only for what you need. See MTCIT for official guidance. We are not lawyers, so your legal adviser should review your privacy notice.
